scripts.build: pnpm --recursive --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm --filter @commonspace/playground build && pnpm --filter @commonspace/consumer-fixture build && pnpm --filter @commonspace/docs build-storybook
scripts.verify: npm run agent:check && node scripts/verify-package-contracts.mjs && node scripts/verify-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/verify-exports.mjs && node scripts/verify-css-contract.mjs && node scripts/verify-docs.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.syntax.json
scripts.agent:generate: npm run knowledge:generate && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/generate-agent-docs.mjs && npm run skills:generate
scripts.agent:check: npm run knowledge:check && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/generate-agent-docs.mjs --check && npm run skills:check
